### inspector-active-findings-kept-until-remediated

**Claim.** Amazon Inspector keeps active findings until they are remediated; it deletes findings 3 days after their resource is deleted, terminated or no longer eligible, and 30 days after they are closed for any other reason.

**Write it as.** `after 3 days` · `after 30 days`

**Scope.** per finding.

> "When a resource is deleted, terminated, or no longer eligible for scanning, Amazon Inspector automatically closes findings associated with the resource and then deletes the findings after 3 days. If findings are closed for any other reason, they are deleted after 30 days."
> — [Understanding Amazon Inspector findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-understanding.html)

> "Amazon Inspector stores all of your active findings until you remediate them."
> — [Understanding Amazon Inspector findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-understanding.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.
